subject: Renewal term synchronization and uplift proposal
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <finance@nebulaai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom@nebulaai.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal quote + mid-year top-up options

Hi Lauren,

We’re starting renewal planning for our Redwood contract that expires 2027-04-01. Usage spiked in Q4 and the team expects continued growth — likely +30% token consumption over the next 6 months. Two asks:

1) Can you send a firm renewal quote including options for adding reserved units mid-contract (we may need a top-up in March)?
2) If we add capacity now, can we sync the new capacity to co-term with our annual renewal on 2027-04-01? Procurement wants a clear invoicing/proration approach so we can route a PO.

Procurement timeline: we need pricing and legal redlines by Feb 10 to hit internal budget windows. Attached is our last quarter usage export.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Finance Manager, NebulaAI
[Attachment: Nebula_usage_Q4-2026.csv (csv)]
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <finance@nebulaai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + mid-year top-up options

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads-up and the usage file. Quick summary of what we can do and next steps: 

- Options: pro-rated mid-contract top-up (one-time invoice) OR reserve additional units with an annualized commitment that can be co-termed to 2027-04-01.
- Anchoring discount: we can offer an early-commit discount on the incremental reserved units if you agree to a co-term and annual billing for the residual period.
- To get you a clean procurement-ready quote I need: expected additional reserved units (est monthly tokens), preferred invoicing cadence, and whether procurement needs a single PO that covers both the current renewal and the mid-contract top-up.

Proposed tactical offer to discuss internally: 12% uplift discount on incremental reserved units if NebulaAI commits to an annualized residual term aligned to 2027-04-01 and pays annually. If you need quarterly invoicing we can do that but discount steps down to 10%.

I attached a short playbook that explains proration math and a pricing matrix example. If that sounds close to what you need, Ben and I can run a short pricing walk tomorrow and then I’ll send a procurement-ready PDF and a redline-friendly term sheet.

Next steps: can you confirm whether procurement prefers PO-first or DocuSign-first?

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NRI_Renewal_Playbook.pdf (pdf)]
From: Elena Ruiz <finance@nebulaai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom@nebulaai.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + mid-year top-up options

Thanks Lauren — that framing helps. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- We prefer to issue a PO that references a signed amendment. DocuSign-first is fine as long as the PO references the DocuSign envelope.
- Quarterly invoicing is strongly preferred for cashflow (can accept the reduced discount if needed).
- NebulaAI can commit to an extra 20% reserved capacity (on top of current) if the effective uplift discount is 10% minimum.

Timeline: we will aim to have a PO ready by Feb 18 if we have a clean PDF and legal redlines by Feb 10. Also attaching the SOC 2 excerpt your security team requested.

Best,
Elena
[Attachment: SOC2-excerpt-2026.pdf (pdf)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <finance@nebulaai.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + mid-year top-up options

Elena — looping in our pricing workstream and proposing a concrete matrix so your team has numbers to run. Summary below, details attached (NRI_pricing_matrix.xlsx):

Option A (Quarterly invoicing, pro-rated top-up):
- One-time mid-contract top-up (adds 20% reserved capacity)
- Effective uplift discount: 10% on incremental units
- Invoiced pro-rata for remainder of term (to 2027-04-01)

Option B (Annualized residual co-term):
- Add 20% reserved capacity & annualize for residual period to 2027-04-01
- Effective uplift discount: 12% on incremental units if paid annually
- Requires simple amendment and DocuSign signature; we’ll accept PO reference on the DocuSign envelope.

Other notes: we can also include a one-time onboarding voucher (10% of incremental monthly capacity credit) to help with burst spikes during ramp.

Attached: pricing matrix, example amendment language, proration worked example. If this looks good I’ll prepare the PDF quote and a redline-friendly amendment and drop the HubSpot deal link in the sheet for your procurement reference.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NRI_pricing_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <finance@nebulaai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + mid-year top-up options

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear timeline. I’ve reviewed Ben’s matrix and can confirm the following final commercial concession we can sign to: 

- We will hold the uplift discount at 12% for the incremental 20% reserved capacity provided NebulaAI: 1) signs the amendment (DocuSign) by Feb 18, and 2) provides a PO referencing the DocuSign envelope within 10 business days of signature.
- If you require quarterly invoicing instead of annual, discount will be 10% (as Ben outlined).

I’ve attached the redline-friendly amendment draft to this thread and populated the HubSpot deal with HS-12345 for procurement tracking. Once Elena confirms acceptance, Lauren will send the DocuSign link (we’ll include a DocuSign reference field so the PO can point to it).

Final ask from procurement: please confirm whether NebulaAI will proceed with annual pay + DocuSign-first (to get 12%) or quarterly pay + PO-first (to get 10%). If you confirm annual, we'll schedule a short legal handoff and produce the final invoice template.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Priyom Das
Head of Growth — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Renewal_Amendment_Draft.docx (docx)]
